easy: When the government takes a person to court to prove that they did a crime.

ex.en: The prosecution of the thief began on Monday.

easy: The lawyers who try to show that a person did a crime.

ex.en: The prosecution asked the judge for more time.
ex.ko: 검찰은 판사에게 시간을 더 달라고 요청했다.

easy: Sensible and based on clear thinking.

ex.en: It is rational to wear a coat when it snows.
ex.ko: 눈이 올 때 외투를 입는 것은 합리적이다.

easy: A number that can be written as one whole number over another, like 1/2.

ex.en: The number 3/4 is a rational number.

easy: An area or field where something is the strongest.

ex.en: In the realm of sports, she is a star.

easy: The land that a king or queen rules.

ex.en: The king ruled his realm with kindness.

easy: A subject or area of knowledge that people talk or learn about.

ex.en: Space is a fun realm to learn about.

easy: A thick, strong cord that you can pull or tie things with.

ex.en: We pulled the rope in tug of war.

easy: To catch an animal by throwing a loop of rope around it.

ex.en: The cowboy roped the calf.

easy: To say something in a very loud voice.

ex.en: Please don't shout in the library.

easy: A long line of tall mountains with sharp tops.

ex.en: We saw a snowy sierra from the airplane.
ex.ko: 우리는 비행기에서 눈 덮인 산맥을 보았다.

easy: A phone that you can also use for the internet, games, and apps.

ex.en: I play a word game on my mom's smartphone.
ex.ko: 나는 엄마의 스마트폰으로 단어 게임을 한다.

easy: Clearly told or decided ahead of time.

ex.en: We eat lunch at the specified time.

easy: Very exciting and grand to look at.

ex.en: The fireworks were spectacular.

easy: Money you pay to get a magazine or newspaper again and again.

ex.en: We pay a subscription for my favorite magazine.
ex.ko: 우리는 내가 좋아하는 잡지의 구독료를 낸다.

easy: Changing from one thing to another.

ex.en: The switch to a new school was exciting for Mia.
ex.ko: 새 학교로 옮기는 일은 미아에게 신나는 일이었다.

easy: Using machines, computers, and new science ideas.

ex.en: Phones and robots are technological inventions.

easy: For a short time only, not forever.

ex.en: Our class is temporarily in the gym.

easy: Letting other people have different ideas and ways without getting angry.

ex.en: Tolerance means being kind to people who are different.
ex.ko: 관용이란 다른 사람들에게 친절하게 대하는 것이다.

easy: In the way people have always done it.

ex.en: Traditionally, Koreans eat rice cake soup on New Year's Day.

easy: Having visited many places around the world.

ex.en: My uncle is well traveled and has visited 30 countries.
ex.ko: 우리 삼촌은 여행을 많이 해서 30개 나라에 가 보았다.

easy: Feeling sad.

ex.en: Sam was unhappy when his dog got lost.

easy: To do something you planned and finish it.

ex.en: She accomplished her goal of reading 20 books.

easy: Good enough for what you need.

ex.en: We have adequate food for the picnic.

easy: Not great and not bad, but good enough.

ex.en: His grade on the quiz was adequate.

easy: To make something different from before.

ex.en: We altered our plan because it started to rain.

easy: To change clothes so they fit you better.

ex.en: Grandma altered my pants to make them shorter.
ex.ko: 할머니가 내 바지를 짧게 고쳐 주셨다.

easy: Words you say when you are sorry for something you did.

ex.en: I made an apology to my friend for being rude.
ex.ko: 나는 무례했던 것에 대해 친구에게 사과했다.

easy: To ask for something in a very strong, serious way.

ex.en: The child begged his mom to let him keep the puppy.
ex.ko: 아이는 엄마에게 강아지를 키우게 해 달라고 애원했다.

easy: To ask people to give you things like money or food for free.

ex.en: The man begged for food on the street.

easy: The happy feeling of being a part of a group.

ex.en: She felt a sense of belonging in her new class.

easy: A fight or contest between two boxers or wrestlers.

ex.en: The boxing bout lasted three rounds.
ex.ko: 그 권투 시합은 세 라운드 동안 이어졌다.

easy: A game where you roll a heavy ball to knock down pins.

ex.en: We went bowling for my birthday.
ex.ko: 우리는 내 생일에 볼링을 치러 갔다.

easy: A shiny yellow metal made by mixing copper and zinc.

ex.en: The door handle is made of brass.

easy: A musical instrument made of metal that you blow into, like a trumpet.

ex.en: The trumpet is a brass instrument.

easy: To make a low humming sound like a bee.

ex.en: Bees were buzzing around the flowers.

easy: To be full of people moving around and making noise.

ex.en: The playground was buzzing with kids at recess.

easy: When someone famous becomes popular again after a break.

ex.en: The singer made a big comeback this year.
ex.ko: 그 가수는 올해 크게 재기에 성공했다.

easy: To say something in a strong, sure way.

ex.en: The coach declared that our team would win.
ex.ko: 코치님은 우리 팀이 이길 것이라고 단언했다.

easy: To say something strongly because you are sure it is true.

ex.en: He declared that he did not break the window.
ex.ko: 그는 자기가 창문을 깨지 않았다고 분명히 말했다.

easy: An engine that burns a heavy oil to make a truck or bus go.

ex.en: The big truck has a loud diesel engine.
ex.ko: 그 큰 트럭에는 시끄러운 디젤 엔진이 달려 있다.

easy: To put something in a liquid for a moment and take it out.

ex.en: She dipped her toe in the cold pool.
ex.ko: 그녀는 차가운 수영장에 발가락을 살짝 담갔다.

easy: To put food into a sauce or drink before you eat it.

ex.en: I dip my fries in ketchup.

easy: To go down for a short time.

ex.en: The temperature dipped at night.

easy: To make a small round mark with a pen or pencil.

ex.en: Dot the i at the end of the word.

easy: How well something works to get the result you want.

ex.en: The effectiveness of this medicine is very high.

easy: Much more than usual.

ex.en: She has an exceptional talent for drawing.

easy: Turning water into ice by making it very cold.

ex.en: Freezing water turns it into ice.

easy: A picture with lines or bars that shows numbers.

ex.en: Our class made a graph of favorite fruits.
ex.ko: 우리 반은 좋아하는 과일 그래프를 만들었다.

easy: A picture that shows information in a clear way.

ex.en: The chart shows how many books each kid read.
ex.ko: 그 도표는 아이들이 각자 읽은 책의 수를 보여 준다.

easy: Not knowing many things because you never had the chance to learn.

ex.en: He was ignorant of the rules because he was new.

easy: Not knowing much about one subject.

ex.en: I am ignorant about how cars work.
ex.ko: 나는 자동차가 어떻게 움직이는지 잘 모른다.

easy: Not knowing about something because no one told you.

ex.en: She was ignorant of the surprise party.
ex.ko: 그녀는 깜짝 파티에 대해 알지 못했다.

easy: To talk and do things with other people.

ex.en: Kids interact with each other at recess.

easy: Thinking carefully to make a decision.

ex.en: Good judgment helps you choose the right thing.
ex.ko: 좋은 판단력은 올바른 것을 고르게 도와준다.

easy: Something that gives off light.

ex.en: The lamp lit up the dark room.

easy: A thing with a light bulb that you put on a desk or table.

ex.en: I read under the lamp on my desk.
ex.ko: 나는 책상 위 전등 아래에서 책을 읽는다.

easy: The grand, wonderful look of something very big.

ex.en: We were amazed by the majesty of the mountains.

easy: Having to do with the middle number when numbers are put in order.

ex.en: The median number of 3, 5, and 9 is 5.

easy: In the middle.

ex.en: The median line runs down the center of the road.

easy: How easily you or a thing can move around.

ex.en: A wheelchair gives her more mobility.
ex.ko: 휠체어는 그녀가 더 잘 움직일 수 있게 해 준다.

easy: A gas in the air that glows red-orange in signs.

ex.en: Neon is used in bright shop signs.

easy: The direction something is facing.

ex.en: The orientation of the house is toward the south.

easy: A hot box in the kitchen for baking food.

ex.en: Mom baked cookies in the oven.

easy: A small book from your country that lets you travel to other countries.

ex.en: We showed our passports at the airport.

easy: Money that you get from selling something.

ex.en: The proceeds of the bake sale went to the school.

easy: A small furry animal with long ears that hops.

ex.en: The rabbit hopped across the garden.

easy: To stop working because you are old enough to rest.

ex.en: My grandfather retired last year.

easy: To stop being part of something you did before.

ex.en: The famous player retired from soccer.

easy: To move back or away.

ex.en: The soldiers retired from the hill.

easy: Wild and a little scary.

ex.en: A savage wolf growled at the hikers.

easy: To lose weight and get thinner.

ex.en: He slimmed down by playing soccer every day.
ex.ko: 그는 매일 축구를 해서 살을 뺐다.

easy: At some time in the future that is not yet set.

ex.en: Someday I want to be an astronaut.

easy: Knowing a lot about the world and acting in a polished way.

ex.en: She wore a sophisticated dress to the party.
ex.ko: 그녀는 파티에 세련된 드레스를 입고 갔다.

easy: Made with new, clever ideas and many parts.

ex.en: A rocket is a sophisticated machine.

easy: Junk email that you did not ask for.

ex.en: Mom deleted the spam in her inbox.
ex.ko: 엄마는 받은 편지함의 스팸 메일을 지웠다.

easy: To send lots of junk email to people.

ex.en: Someone spammed us with ads.
ex.ko: 누군가 우리에게 광고 스팸 메일을 보냈다.

easy: A neat pile of things on top of each other.

ex.en: There is a stack of books on my desk.
ex.ko: 내 책상 위에 책 더미가 있다.

easy: The way you stand.

ex.en: The batter took a wide stance.

easy: The way you think or feel about something.

ex.en: Our school has a strong stance against bullying.
ex.ko: 우리 학교는 괴롭힘에 강하게 반대하는 입장이다.

easy: Having to do with the tiny electric sparks you get from rubbing things.

ex.en: A balloon rubbed on hair makes static electricity.

easy: Staying the same without much change.

ex.en: The number of kids in our class stayed static.
ex.ko: 우리 반 아이들 수는 변하지 않았다.

easy: A tunnel under a road that people walk through.

ex.en: We walked through the subway to cross the road.

easy: Helping and encouraging you.

ex.en: My supportive parents cheered at my game.
ex.ko: 나를 응원해 주는 부모님이 내 경기에서 환호하셨다.

easy: Having to do with doctors cutting the body to fix a problem.

ex.en: The doctor put on surgical gloves.

easy: Needing an operation by a doctor to be fixed.

ex.en: A broken bone can be a surgical problem.
ex.ko: 부러진 뼈는 수술이 필요한 문제일 수 있다.

easy: A flat piece of stone with words carved on it.

ex.en: The old stone tablet had writing on it.

easy: Paper sheets joined at the top for writing notes.

ex.en: I wrote my phone number on the tablet.

easy: A cloth house on poles that you sleep in when you camp.

ex.en: We slept in a tent by the lake.

easy: To stay outside in a tent for fun.

ex.en: Can we go camping again this summer?
ex.ko: 이번 여름에 또 캠핑 갈 수 있을까요?

easy: A long paper written after a lot of study, often for a college degree.

ex.en: My aunt wrote a thesis about bees.
ex.ko: 우리 이모는 벌에 대한 학위 논문을 썼다.

easy: The sea rising up the beach and going back down each day.

ex.en: The tide came in and covered our sandcastle.

easy: Making things warm.

ex.en: We sat by the warming fire.

easy: Taking money out of a bank.

ex.en: Dad made a withdrawal at the bank.

easy: The way a person or animal grows older over time.

ex.en: Aging makes hair turn gray.

easy: Getting older.

ex.en: Our aging dog sleeps a lot.
ex.ko: 나이 들어가는 우리 강아지는 잠을 많이 잔다.

easy: A company that flies people in airplanes.

ex.en: We flew on a Korean airline.

easy: A check of a company's money records by an expert.

ex.en: The company had an audit of its money.

easy: To check records carefully to make sure they are right.

ex.en: An accountant audited the school's records.

easy: True and something you can believe.

ex.en: Her story was authentic, so we believed it.
ex.ko: 그녀의 이야기는 믿을 만해서 우리는 믿었다.

easy: Real, not a fake or a copy.

ex.en: This is an authentic Korean hanbok.

easy: Toward the back.

ex.en: The car moved backward.

easy: In the opposite way from normal.

ex.en: He put his shirt on backward.

easy: Having light yellow hair.

ex.en: My cousin has blond hair.

easy: To break something so it no longer works.

ex.en: I busted my toy car by dropping it.

easy: An open space with no trees in the middle of a forest.

ex.en: We ate lunch in a clearing in the woods.

easy: The part of a shirt that goes around your neck.

ex.en: The collar of my shirt is itchy.

easy: To do what a rule or a person tells you to do.

ex.en: Please comply with the classroom rules.

easy: Making you feel shivery, like bugs are crawling on you.

ex.en: The ghost story was creepy.

easy: No longer married because the marriage was ended by law.

ex.en: Her parents are divorced, so she has two homes.
ex.ko: 그녀의 부모님은 이혼하셔서 그녀는 집이 두 곳이다.

easy: Not wet anymore.

ex.en: The paint is dried, so you can touch it.

easy: Made dry so it keeps for a long time.

ex.en: I like dried mango as a snack.

easy: In a way that shows strong feelings.

ex.en: She spoke emotionally about her lost cat.
ex.ko: 그녀는 잃어버린 고양이에 대해 감정이 북받쳐 이야기했다.

easy: In the way you feel inside.

ex.en: The kids felt emotionally safe at school.

easy: To make something bigger, stronger, or higher.

ex.en: Music can enhance the fun of a party.
ex.ko: 음악은 파티의 즐거움을 더 높여 줄 수 있다.

easy: To make something better.

ex.en: Cheese will enhance the flavor of the pizza.
ex.ko: 치즈는 피자의 맛을 더 좋게 해 준다.

easy: The last part of a piece of music.

ex.en: The band played a loud finale.

easy: The last part of a show or event.

ex.en: The fireworks were the finale of the show.

easy: The taste that food has in your mouth.

ex.en: I love the flavor of strawberry ice cream.
ex.ko: 나는 딸기 아이스크림의 맛을 아주 좋아한다.

easy: A person who plays the harp.

ex.en: The harper played a soft song.

easy: A grown-up male deer with big antlers.

ex.en: A stag stood quietly in the forest.
ex.ko: 수사슴 한 마리가 숲속에 조용히 서 있었다.

easy: Not knowing something because you have not learned it.

ex.en: Ignorance of the rules can get you in trouble.

easy: Making you feel brave, hopeful, and excited to try.

ex.en: The coach gave an inspiring speech.

easy: Between two things.

ex.en: Gray is an intermediate color between black and white.
ex.ko: 회색은 검정과 하양 사이의 중간 색이다.

easy: Not too big and not too small.

ex.en: I ordered an intermediate size cup.
